Question ID: SPEECH_U04_L04_Quiz_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.RES.04

Source excerpt for item 1: A speaker uses source details to make a careful inference for a research-supported presentation. Which choice best shows supported inference skill?

answer.text: A. Make a guess with no source support

feedback.text: This answer shows a misconception. Return to the source details and check whether the choice supports accurate research-based speaking.

answer.text: B. Repeat one word from the source without reasoning

feedback.text: This answer is not strong enough because it does not connect source understanding to the speech purpose and audience need.

answer.text: C. Base the inference on direct details from the source

feedback.text: Correct. This answer uses the source accurately and connects the information to research-supported speech communication.

answer.text: D. Ignore the direct details in the source

feedback.text: This answer weakens communication by relying on a surface detail instead of accurate source comprehension.
